issue: सब घट तुम आप बखानी माँ — बखानी (Platts bakhān: description, declaration, praise) is read as passive, 'you yourself are described so' (as dwelling in every heart); it could be active, 'you yourself have declared it'.
our reading: You are in every heart, Mother; you yourself are described so.
alternatives: You are in every heart, Mother: so you yourself have declared

issue: शिव मूर्ति माया — read as two epithets, 'the embodiment of Śiva, and Māyā'; शिव may be the adjective 'auspicious' (शिव मूर्ति: of auspicious form).
our reading: You are the embodiment of Śiva, and Māyā.
alternatives: You are of auspicious form, and Māyā
